items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: [MR. BERGER] This is an interview with Benny Carter, conducted by Marl Berger...

ctx.x: This is an interview with Benny Carter, conducted by Marl Berger as part of the oral jazz history program of the Smithsonian Institution. We are in Princeton, and this is October 13, 1976.
Benny, to begin at the beginning, let's just ask where and when you were born.
